title: Open edX Installer Experiment Variables
description: Suite-specific CLI and environment overrides for the Open edX Vagrant, installer, and guest UI verification campaign.

TARGET_OS.description: Target guest OS booted via Vagrant from the configured Bento fork (e.g., windows-11, debian-13, rockylinux-10.2, macos-14-arm64).

BENTO_PREFIX.description: Configurable Vagrant box namespace or Bento fork prefix.

BENTO_DIR.description: Optional path to a local Bento fork checkout containing built .box images.

PROVIDER.description: Vagrant hypervisor provider used to run guest VMs.

PKG_FORMAT.description: Target native installer format evaluated inside the guest VM.

PKG_SOURCE.description: Whether to download the target package from GitHub Releases or build anew on the host.

RELEASE_REPO.description: GitHub owner/repository queried when PKG_SOURCE is github-release.

INSTALL_MODES.description: Comma-separated installation modes executed individually on clean vanilla VM snapshots.

FORCE_REBUILD.description: Set to 1 to force re-downloading/rebuilding packages and re-running converged install modes.

DRY_RUN.description: Set to 1 to emit the resolved execution plan and ordered verification matrix without starting Vagrant.
